digest.component_or_area: rebar graph hierarchy and dependency resolver
propositions: rebar link can silently record a different edge than requested when tickets are at different type tiers but share a parent
blocking edges can exist between a ticket and its own ancestors or descendants, distorting ready/next-batch and violating the parent-first claim cascade
blocking-link comparability must be decided from the parent hierarchy (nearest common ancestor) rather than from ticket type tier
legacy blocking edges written under the type-tier rule must be detectable and repairable store-wide without breaking the escalation contract
escalation redirect records are discarded on the library and MCP call paths due to quiet=True output redirection, preserving the silence bug from 1803-df54-18bb-4881
